title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: ‘while also ensuring geographical balance among all Member States at every staff level;’ underscores that achieving fair geographical representation at all levels of the administration, also taking into account age and gender, is essential to fostering a genuinely European public service; notes that Parliament has taken measures to support this objective, including the organisation of nationality-specific competitions; highlights the need to accelerate the competitions’ processes while maintaining a strict merit-based selection approach;’
